title: Share immutable Resource snapshot records between browser and Linux recorder Hosts
body:
The recorder must eventually use symmetric browser and Linux/Pi stores. Its existing immutable snapshot record codec currently lives inside the browser runtime. Extract only that bounded record preparation/publication/restore implementation into a generic no-std/alloc mechanism, preserving record bytes, storage key derivation, exact reference version/extent, current residence and independent authority checks.

Keep browser public paths as re-exports, retain browser Host Call request correlation and effect execution in place, and move the existing sealed-placement fixture tests to the generic owner without duplicating their implementation. Add a supported cargo xtask check covering generic codec tests, browser operation tests and strict codec lint. Scope excludes a filesystem provider, catalog seed custody, Body admission, Line or complete recorder deployment; those remain subsequent appliance work. Refs #6325 and #6347.


## Current omnibus admission (2026-10-24 UTC)

Current codec head941275 and the explicit feature-enabled browser operation-proof step are retained in the omnibus. Supported combinedsource5ace passed5 generic record tests,5 browser codec tests, all3 actual storage-operation regressions and strict codec lint. Exact workspace coverage and standalone-lock inventory checks also pass in the final source chain. Linux storage execution, recorder deployment and physical effects are not inferred from codec extraction.

Current delivery source is `d677b25383b22ca2911f1ec49936ca7b4a3c86ee` in existing PR #6339, with fresh [Candidate40054154999](https://github.com/dancxjo/conduit/actions/runs/40054154999). No additional PR was opened. [Current registry repair, exact positive test and preflight proof](https://github.com/dancxjo/conduit/tree/d43f2818a0143dcdb81ee319ee11c975a578f5cc/docs/audits/evidence/reviewed-omnibus-lock-registry-20261024/d677b2538); [source-qualified production/Face proof](https://github.com/dancxjo/conduit/tree/dc6cdb60a0214d50c05b3396b0f862c02e0354d7/docs/audits/evidence/reviewed-omnibus-final-20261024/eacbd8350). Full exact-head Candidate, actual dev delivery, applicable Integration and final scoped audits remain required; no issue closure from these local checks.
